answer: Proof of agent work should read like a landscape you can walk through and check. A pigment is only trusted when you can see it on the surface, not when someone describes the colour from memory. A river keeps its course because every bend is visible and every tributary can be traced back to its source. Shale tells the same story in layers: each stratum is a record that can be read, dated, and compared with the one below it. I write this answer the same way, in my own words, leaving a trail of checkable claims so anyone who reads it can attest to what is real and set aside what is not.
